parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel of the table made of wood, rectangular in shape, providing lateral support.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the legs and supports the tabletop structure, maintaining rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A second vertical side panel of the table made of wood, similar to the first one, providing structural stability.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the legs and supports the tabletop structure, maintaining rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A wooden leg of the table, rectangular and elongated, supporting the table vertically.
parts.Functional_description: It bears the load of the tabletop and provides elevation and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A second wooden leg of the table, identical in function and shape to the other legs.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the table and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A third wooden leg of the table, providing vertical support.
parts.Functional_description: It helps distribute the load evenly across the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: A fourth wooden leg of the table, completing the support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It stabilizes the table and prevents tipping.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located under the tabletop, rectangular in shape with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It provides storage space for small items and can be pulled out or pushed in.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out of the table frame.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden back panel located behind the drawer, rectangular and thin.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the back of the drawer compartment and adds structural rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden tabletop forming the upper surface of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for placing objects, writing, or working.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
